meta.note: Read-only audit. No builder, no Fatigue/Travel/Rest Score, no route inference, no crawling.

previousGameMapping.joinPath: prediction.gameId → starter-dataset-v1 (gamePk, teamId, side, cutoffTime) → Stats API schedule cache team timeline
previousGameMapping.cacheWindowCaveat: 100% mapping holds when schedule cache includes prior team games; season-first games or cache boundary → joinQuality=MISSING_PREVIOUS (no inference)

actualEndAvailability.playByPlayEndTime: POST_GAME via playByPlay allPlays last endTime (heavy; optional accuracy audit)
actualEndAvailability.preGameUsableForPreviousFinal: Only if previous game Final AND ended before target cutoffTime

unavailableOrCutoffGated: hoursSincePreviousFinal (when previous not Final before cutoff)

straightLineDistanceKm.nature: Approximate observation only — not flight or drive distance
straightLineDistanceKm.legalNote: Computed derivative from MLB Stats API venue coordinates (INTERNAL_RESEARCH_ONLY)

doubleheader.policy: Previous game may be same-day gameNumber-1; doubleheaderStatus=GAME1|GAME2|SINGLE; rest hours use scheduled starts

postponed.detection: status.detailedState contains Postponed; may lack Final
postponed.policy: Skip as previous game if not Final; joinQuality=MISSING_PREVIOUS or PREVIOUS_POSTPONED; warning

suspended.policy: Do not use partial suspended game innings pre-cutoff; POST_GAME_ACTUAL_CONTEXT only after Final

rescheduled.policy: Record originalScheduledStart separately; use actual scheduled gameDate for rest/travel; versioned snapshot

neutralVenue.policy: warnings NEUTRAL_OR_TEMPORARY_VENUE; travel distance still from coordinates

overseas.policy: warnings INTERNATIONAL_VENUE; timezone offset especially important

sameDayPrevious.policy: hoursSincePreviousScheduledStart may be <24; gamesInLast2Days includes both

previousMissing.policy: No inference — joinQuality=MISSING_PREVIOUS; leave rest/travel counts null

PRE_GAME_SCHEDULE_CONTEXT.allowedInputs: Schedule and venue facts known at or before cutoffTime; scheduled starts; venue ids; static coordinates/timezone from venue registry cache

POST_GAME_ACTUAL_CONTEXT.allowedInputs: linescore innings, playByPlay endTime, actual end-based rest — accuracy audit only

leakageRisks.risk: Post-game innings/end-time backfilled into PRE_GAME_SCHEDULE_CONTEXT row
Rescheduled schedule fetched after cutoff applied to past snapshot
leakageRisks.mitigation: Versioned schedule snapshot at collection; inputHash lock

leakageRisks.risk: Using target game result fields as travel/rest features
leakageRisks.mitigation: Explicit forbidden feature list in builder contract

leakageRisks.risk: Previous game not Final but innings/end time used
leakageRisks.mitigation: previousGameInnings only when previous status Final before cutoff

missingDataRisks: Prediction lacks gamePk/venue — starter dependency (same as weather)
Schedule cache window may omit season-first previous game
No schedule-level game end timestamp — actual-end rest is POST_GAME or unavailable
Timezone not in schedule cache — requires venue hydrate=timezone
Coordinates not in schedule cache — requires venue hydrate=location
KST slate vs officialDate mismatch for gamesInLastNDays windows
Doubleheader/resumed games rare in audit sample — policies unvalidated at scale

apiCallEstimate100Games.scheduleWindowCold: 1–7 date-range schedule calls per slate day (reusable across teams on same dates)
apiCallEstimate100Games.venueMetadataCold: ~25–30 unique venueIds (coordinates + timezone), cacheable per season
apiCallEstimate100Games.linescorePostGameCold: Up to 200 linescore calls worst case (2 teams × 100 games) — POST_GAME phase only
apiCallEstimate100Games.derivedPreviousGameIndex: Built from cached schedule — 0 incremental when warm

cacheStrategy.dedupe: team timeline rebuilt from immutable schedule cache slices; venue by venueId

legalStatus.straightLineDistance: Computed haversine from official venue coordinates — derivative; public display requires separate legal review
legalStatus.betmanIndependence: Betman schedule scope independent from travel/rest data sources

candidateHypotheses: H-TR-001: Short rest interval may relate to game volatility (not registered)
H-TR-002: Long travel before first game may relate to game flow (not registered)
H-TR-003: Consecutive road games may explain more than single distance (not registered)
H-TR-004: Timezone change may have effect independent of distance (not registered)
H-TR-005: Doubleheader or extra-inning prior game fatigue patterns (not registered)

minimalSchemaDraft.rowGranularity: one row per team per game (30 rows for 15-game slate)

openQuestions: Rolling schedule window size for previous-game lookup (7/14/30 days vs full season cache)
Whether POST_GAME_ACTUAL_CONTEXT rows ship in v1 builder or deferred to v1.1
Static venue registry versioning shared with Weather dataset
KST vs officialDate rule for gamesInLastNDays on cross-midnight slates
